# Karban

> Karban (karbanapp.ir) is a smart assistant for Iranian labor law and employment contracts: ready-made contracts, labor-law calculators (salary, severance, overtime, tax, VAT), and a labor-law knowledge base.

## Main pages
- https://karbanapp.ir/خدمات: Services overview
- https://karbanapp.ir/قراردادها: Employment contract templates
- https://karbanapp.ir/ابزارهای-هوش-مصنوعی: Labor law calculators
- https://karbanapp.ir/دانشنامه: Labor law knowledge base

## Contact
- Email: info@karbanapp.ir
